name: onetake

latest_release.name: onetake 1.1.0-lite
latest_release.body:
The free edition, two weeks after launch.

- **Built-in looks** — six measured palettes with OFL faces (`looks/`, `scripts/look.py`)
- **The onetake launch film, recut** — the three films now gather into one row
- **The onetake logo**

Free for noncommercial use under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.

### Commercial work → onetake Pro

A one-time commercial licence (client work included), plus the full source and version history of 10 case films, 5 film-type starters, the judgement notes behind every rejected cut, and the sound kit. Every 1.x update included.

**https://onetakemotion.com**

---

免费版上线两周后的版本：内置 6 套实测配色（OFL 字体），重剪了 onetake 发布片的结尾，加上了 onetake logo。

需要商用：**onetake Pro** 提供一次性买断的商业授权（可接客户单），并附带 10 部片子的完整源码与版本历史、5 个片型 starter、每次被否的判断笔记和音效包 → https://onetakemotion.com
